description.value: Templeton Park Pool is a City of Vancouver-operated indoor aquatic facility in the Grandview-Woodland neighbourhood, featuring an inground pool and sauna. It is a fully accessible public recreation centre serving drop-in swimmers and community programs. Touring cyclists in East Vancouver will find it a convenient stop for a swim and use of change facilities.
